problem_text:
A logistics manager must select packages to load onto a cargo drone. Available packages are:
* Package A: volume 4 m³, revenue $274
* Package B: volume 3 m³, revenue $56
* Package C: volume 48 m³, revenue $58
* Package D: volume 38 m³, revenue $80
* Package E: volume 10 m³, revenue $298
* Package F: volume 14 m³, revenue $193
* Package G: volume 24 m³, revenue $61
* Package H: volume 7 m³, revenue $202
* Package I: volume 32 m³, revenue $74
* Package J: volume 22 m³, revenue $277
* Package K: volume 14 m³, revenue $124
* Package L: volume 49 m³, revenue $237
* Package M: volume 39 m³, revenue $156
* Package N: volume 7 m³, revenue $81
* Package O: volume 27 m³, revenue $58
* Package P: volume 48 m³, revenue $106
* Package Q: volume 46 m³, revenue $76
* Package R: volume 12 m³, revenue $146
* Package S: volume 18 m³, revenue $176
* Package T: volume 11 m³, revenue $238
* Package U: volume 46 m³, revenue $182

The drone's cargo hold has a maximum capacity of 363 m³. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this volume limit. Each package is either fully loaded or left behind.
